title: PrepWise
subtitle: AI-Powered Personalized Mock Interview Platform
summary: An AI-powered mock interview platform that generates personalized interviews based on user preferences or uploaded resumes.
problemSolved: Generic mock interviews fail to adapt to an individual's experience and background. PrepWise uses resume information to generate personalized interview questions and provide instant feedback.
technicalChallenge: Integrating resume parsing, AI-driven question generation, and real-time interview feedback into a seamless full-stack application.
outcomeKey: Launched an AI-powered interview platform that attracted 30+ users within the first few days and enabled personalized interview preparation.
highlights: Resume PDF parsing for tailored questions
30+ users within the first few days of launch

title: NewsGuard AI
subtitle: BERT-Powered Fake News Detection Browser Extension
summary: A Firefox browser extension that detects fake news in real time using a BERT-based NLP model trained on the FakeNewsNet dataset.
problemSolved: Users can encounter misleading or fabricated news while browsing the web. NewsGuard AI provides real-time news verification directly inside the browser.
technicalChallenge: Integrating a trained BERT NLP model with a browser extension through a Flask backend while maintaining an efficient real-time verification workflow.
outcomeKey: Built a real-time fake news detection system achieving 97.37% accuracy on the trained NLP model.
highlights: BERT-based NLP model trained on FakeNewsNet

terminalLogs.text: [FLASK] Prediction API ready for incoming requests

title: Autonomous QA Agent
subtitle: RAG-Based Autonomous Test Scenario & Selenium Generator
summary: A full-stack AI application that uses RAG, vector embeddings, and a dual-agent architecture to generate test scenarios from technical documentation and convert them into executable Selenium scripts.
problemSolved: Manual test planning and test-script creation can be repetitive and time-consuming. The Autonomous QA Agent automates documentation analysis, test scenario generation, and Selenium script creation.
technicalChallenge: Combining document retrieval, vector embeddings, autonomous reasoning, HTML DOM analysis, and code generation into a coordinated dual-agent testing workflow.
outcomeKey: Reduced manual test creation effort by 40% through autonomous test scenario generation and Selenium script conversion.
highlights: HTML DOM analysis for Selenium script generation
40% reduction in manual test creation effort
FastAPI backend with interactive Streamlit interface

title: Intelligent Traffic Control System
subtitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning Based Adaptive Traffic Control
summary: A reinforcement learning-based traffic management system that dynamically controls traffic signals using real-time simulation data.
problemSolved: Static traffic signal timings cannot effectively respond to changing traffic conditions. The system dynamically adapts signal control based on live traffic information.
technicalChallenge: Training and validating a reinforcement learning agent across complex urban traffic simulations while continuously feeding real-time traffic data through the SUMO TraCI API.
outcomeKey: Reduced average vehicle waiting time by over 75% in simulated environments using adaptive reinforcement learning-based traffic signal control.
highlights: Adaptive traffic signal control using reinforcement learning
Over 75% reduction in simulated vehicle wait times
Real-time traffic data processing through SUMO TraCI API

title: Hedwig
subtitle: Real-Time Full-Stack Chat Application
summary: A real-time chat application built for seamless communication with low-latency bi-directional messaging, image sharing, and a responsive user interface.
problemSolved: Traditional request-response communication does not provide the responsiveness required for real-time conversations. Hedwig enables persistent bi-directional communication between users.
technicalChallenge: Implementing low-latency real-time messaging while managing concurrent connections, image storage, persistent application data, and secure responsive access across devices.
outcomeKey: Built and deployed a real-time communication platform supporting over 20 active users with bi-directional messaging.
